section.17: The Book of Praying for Rain (Al-Istisqa')

17.name_native: The Book of Praying for Rain (Al-Istisqa')

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Abdullah bin Abi Bakr that:He heard Abbad bin Tamim said: "The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out and prayed for rain, and he turned his rida' around when he turned to the Qiblah
